title: Soft drink, pepper type, decaffeinated, diet

content.title: About
content.content: A carbonated soft drink flavored with pepper, free of caffeine and sugar. It consists of sparkling water infused with natural pepper extract and non‑caloric sweeteners. The product is aimed at consumers who want a refreshing, slightly spicy taste without calories.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Pepper‑flavored sodas first appeared in Japan in the early 2000s as an alternative to fruit flavors.
Decaffeinated versions allow enjoyment by people sensitive to caffeine.
The diet sweeteners used are approved by EU and US food safety authorities.
Carbonation enhances the perception of pepper aroma by releasing volatile compounds.
Pepper contains capsaicin, which may modestly boost metabolism.

items.title: Metabolism support
items.content: Capsaicin from pepper can slightly increase thermogenesis, helping calorie burning.

items.title: Zero calories
items.content: The sugar‑free, caffeine‑free formula adds no calories, useful for weight management.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: Sparkling water contributes to daily fluid intake.

items.title: Caffeine‑free
items.content: Suitable for individuals avoiding stimulants, including pregnant women and children.

items.title: Antioxidant potential
items.content: Pepper extract provides small amounts of vitamin C and polyphenols.

items.title: Sensitivity to spiciness
items.content: Some people may experience throat or stomach irritation from the pepper flavor.

items.title: Artificial sweeteners
items.content: Certain consumers may have discomfort from sucralose or acesulfame‑K.

items.title: Carbonation
items.content: Excessive intake of carbonated drinks can cause bloating.

items.title: Pepper allergy
items.content: Rare allergic reactions to pepper extract are possible.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve chilled, optionally over ice or with a slice of lemon to enhance freshness. Ideal as a refreshing snack between meals or after workouts.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep refrigerated and consume within 5‑7 days.
